reason_for_review: The same defect class found in A-K5 (a test whose instrument cannot express the property) appears in this probe. Both negatives needed qualification before being read as evidence about wave->text egress.

finding_1_roundtrip_is_tautological.docstring_quote: codebook_M[k] = P(encode(manifest[k])) ... entry k has cosine 1.0 against itself and strictly less against every other entry, so this must be 100% unless two manifest entries are identical strings
finding_1_roundtrip_is_tautological.defect: The codebook entry for token k IS the projected encode of that exact string. Round-trip success is guaranteed BY CONSTRUCTION. Q4 is a self-consistency check on the construction, NOT a content test.
finding_1_roundtrip_is_tautological.consequence: Q4 PASS carries no information about egress capability. It must not be cited as evidence that the closed-vocab path works.

finding_2_salted_hash_null_seed.expression: null = perm_null(idxs, V, N_NULL, seed + hash(tmpl) % 1000)
finding_2_salted_hash_null_seed.defect: hash(tmpl) is CPython's SALTED str hash (PYTHONHASHSEED). The permutation-null seed is therefore NOT reproducible across processes.
finding_2_salted_hash_null_seed.severity: MINOR. The null remains a valid null in form; only the exact draw varies. It does not invalidate the null distribution.
finding_2_salted_hash_null_seed.same_defect_class_as: scripts/training/train_henri_decoder.py:54 (target_id = hash(text_target) % 32000), the A-K5 checkpoint's training target
finding_2_salted_hash_null_seed.note: A defect in MY probe, not in the codebook under test.

finding_3_cross_form_mismatch.codebook_entries: BARE tokens: manifest[k] = the token string itself (line 69 builds the codebook from the bare word list)
finding_3_cross_form_mismatch.queries: CARRIER-WRAPPED: line 98 encodes tmpl.format(w=w) for TEMPLATES = ('the {w} report', '{w} is the word', 'describe {w} now')
finding_3_cross_form_mismatch.defect: Entries are bare; queries are carrier-wrapped. A carrier query shares only the word-feature plus n-gram features the bare entry does not contain.
finding_3_cross_form_mismatch.consequence: Q1/Q2 measure CROSS-FORM GENERALIZATION, not bare-token retrieval. The measured failure is scoped to that harder task.

what_the_negative_actually_means.corrected_statement: HoloEgressCodebook is an EXACT-STRING LOOKUP, not a decoder. It returns entry k only for the exact wave of manifest[k] (tautologically). Inside a carrier phrase the specificity margin is NEGATIVE on most templates (observed means roughly -0.16, +0.15, -0.21, -0.35, -0.25 across seed/template combinations).
what_the_negative_actually_means.therefore: The codebook has no demonstrated compositional unbinding ability.
what_the_negative_actually_means.but: This is a property of THIS codebook design (tokenizer-derived nearest-neighbour table), not a measurement of wave->text egress in principle.

correction_to_prior_framing.prior_claim: Two independent egress paths now fail the same specificity test (closed-vocab -0.21; unbinder -0.031).
correction_to_prior_framing.corrected_claim: The shared numeric outcome is real, but the two failures have DIFFERENT causes and neither tests wave->text egress in principle.
correction_to_prior_framing.ak5_unbinder: BLOCKED -- degenerate training target (random waves, random labels, salted-hash ids) AND representation-family mismatch (dense Gaussian training vs sparse block-structured codec waves). Status UNMEASURED.
correction_to_prior_framing.closed_vocab_codebook: Negative -- exact-string lookup with no cross-form generalization. This is a real limitation of that design.
correction_to_prior_framing.shared_root_cause: NONE established. The prior framing implied a common architectural fault; the evidence does not support that implication.

what_survives.ak4_text_splice: PASS, unaffected (different mechanism: retrieved text into the prompt)
what_survives.zonec_ladder: R1/R2/R3 T1_SUPPORTED +40%, unstructured T1_FALSIFIED, three scales

status_of_wave_to_text_egress: UNMEASURED. Two adjacent attempts produced one BLOCKED artifact and one design-limited negative. Neither is a test of the mechanism.
